meta.name: ppt-generator
meta.description: 基于七角色协作的智能 PPT 生成与优化工具。支持主题生成、模板推荐、内容填充、AI 智能配图、文本润色和 PPTX 文件生成。适用于学术汇报、商业演示、培训课件、产品发布等多种场景。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据主题自动生成专业演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作结构完整、视觉美观的PPT
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional presentations from a topic
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create well-structured, visually appealing slides

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会以七个角色协作的方式帮您制作PPT：先分析主题、推荐模板布局，再撰写和润色内容、给出配图建议，最后生成可下载的PPTX文件；也可用于优化现有PPT或只输出大纲。
howto.when: 当您提出需要制作PPT、优化已有PPT内容，或要求基于某个主题生成演示文稿时，这项技能会自动接管。

say.text: 帮我生成一份商业计划书PPT，受众是投资人，15页
say.note: 会执行完整七角色流程并生成PPTX文件

say.text: 把我这份PPT内容润色一下，重新组织结构
say.note: 会重点做语言润色和结构优化

say.text: 只给我一个产品发布PPT的大纲和布局建议
say.note: 进入快速模式，不生成文件

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude works as seven collaborating roles to create PPTs: analyzing the topic, recommending template layouts, writing and polishing content, suggesting images, and finally generating a downloadable PPTX file. It can also optimize existing PPTs or output just an outline.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a PPT, optimize an existing presentation, or generate a slide deck based on a topic.

say_en.text: Create a business plan PPT for investors, 15 slides.
say_en.note: Runs the full seven-role flow and generates a PPTX file.

say_en.text: Polish this PPT content and restructure it.
say_en.note: Focuses on language polish and structural optimization.

say_en.text: Just give me an outline and layout suggestions for a product launch.
say_en.note: Uses quick mode; no file is generated.
